meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: Claude 会把你已有的说话人/访谈/播客视频加上与语音同步的动画图形卡片,如动态标题、下方字幕条、数据标注、引文、侧栏、画中画;原视频完整保留。卡片在对话里设计并写成 HTML,最后渲染成一个带图形的 MP4 视频,画布比例可选 16:9、9:16 或 4:5。
howto.when: 当你说要给视频添加图形覆盖(如 graphic overlays、on-screen graphics),或要求给视频做包装/装扮(package/dress up)时触发。只是要普通字幕则不会触发。

say.text: 给我的访谈视频加上数据标注的图形卡片。
say.note: Claude 会分析转录,设计卡片并渲染 MP4。

say.text: 给这段播客视频配动态标题和下方字幕条,用竖屏。
say.note: 会按 9:16 画布生成叠加图形的视频。

say.text: 把这条短视频包装一下,加引文和侧栏信息。
say.note: 会生成带引文和侧栏的图形覆盖。

howto.what_en: Claude overlays timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data, quotes, side panels, PiP) on an existing talking-head video, synced to speech. Original clip untouched. Cards become HTML in chat, then render to MP4 on 16:9, 9:16 or 4:5 canvas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for graphic overlays, on-screen graphics, or packaging/dressing up a video. Plain subtitles do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Add data callout graphic cards to my interview video.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the transcript, design cards and render an MP4.

say_en.text: Add kinetic titles and lower-thirds to this podcast video, portrait mode.
say_en.note: Renders an MP4 with overlay cards on a 9:16 canvas.

say_en.text: Dress up this short video with quotes and a side panel.
say_en.note: Generates graphic overlays with quote and sidebar.
